attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Custom biped controller orient fixes. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. FixArms: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. FixClavicles: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. FixPelvis: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. FixLegs: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. FixToes: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. FixFingers: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. FixMisc: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. Tip: if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
